scope: Alternatives to fixed-scale selection and post-hoc table correction for improving a frozen TeleOCR comparator
workflow: Targeted primary-source literature search and synthesis; no independent review or model reproduction.
limitations: Targeted search, not systematic or exhaustive review
No experiments or model reproductions performed
No located source establishes improvement over this project's pinned TeleOCR under its full-page matched protocol
Architecture novelty, training compatibility and resource feasibility remain unverified

search.include: Primary papers and author repositories; 2023-2026; table generation, document post-training, verifiable supervision, long-table decomposition
search.exclude: Secondary summaries as evidence; table QA-only work as direct OCR evidence; incomparable scores as rankings

historical_correction.finding: Explicit-v2 already combined image, cell boxes, OCR tokens and cross-modal grounding; best released checkpoint adopted zero edits. OCR consensus sidecar had tiny gain and known crop defect; complete-cell follow-up regressed. Generic image-grounded correction is not a new project direction.
historical_correction.causality_limit: These aggregate failures do not isolate causes among labels, architecture, decoding and action admission.

sources.title: TeleOCR: Navigating Document Parsing Across Digital and Camera-Captured Documents
sources.coverage: Abstract and targeted methods sections 3.3,4.3,4.4; author README
sources.finding: Already trains geometric perception, content/structure decoupling and GRPO with TEDS/CDM rewards. Merely adding geometry or RL is not a substantiated new capability.
sources.comparability: Paper 96.87 differs from official leaderboard row96.91 and local D0; do not merge.

sources.title: StrucTab: A Structured Optimization Framework for Table Parsing
sources.finding: Intermediate row/column and merged-cell tasks plus decomposed validity/structure/content rewards train the generator. Full setup uses millions of pretraining examples and16H20 GPUs; not a small pilot recipe.
sources.comparability: OmniDocBench v1.5 table subset512; no TeleOCR comparison located; not our full1651-page end-to-end protocol.
sources.availability: Data construction/rewards/benchmark code verified in README; deployable model checkpoint not verified.

sources.title: TRivia: Self-supervised Fine-tuning of Vision-Language Models for Table Recognition
sources.finding: QA-derived rewards train a table generator beyond supervised fine-tuning. Direct teacher pseudo-label alternatives regressed in its ablation. Large teacher/validator and substantial prior training are required in the published recipe.
sources.comparability: Uses GT-cropped512-table OmniDocBench v1.5 subset, not matched end-to-end TeleOCR.
sources.availability: README marks model and training code released; data-generation pipeline TODO incomplete.

sources.title: olmOCR 2: Unit Test Rewards for Document OCR
sources.finding: Known rendered HTML supplies verifiable tests;2186synthetic pages contain30381tests. This follows substantial SFT; RL uses8H100,28completions per document and six-run weight averaging. Small page count does not imply cheap end-to-end replication.
sources.comparability: English olmOCR-Bench; not evidence of superiority over TeleOCR on OmniDocBench.

sources.title: TDATR: Improving End-to-End Table Recognition via Table Detail-Aware Learning and Cell-Level Visual Alignment
sources.coverage: Official CVPR abstract and bibliographic record; full experimental details not verified
sources.finding: Perceive-then-fuse intermediate tasks and integrated cell localization improve a generating model. Generic grounding has prior art; this source does not establish small-data TeleOCR gains.

sources.title: Divide Rows and Conquer Cells: Towards Structure Recognition for Large Tables
sources.coverage: Official IJCAI abstract and bibliographic record
sources.finding: Non-autoregressive row decoding followed by semi-autoregressive cell decoding addresses long-sequence error accumulation.
sources.comparability: Structure recognition evidence; inference-only cropping of TeleOCR would be an unvalidated adaptation, not reproduction.

sources.title: What Does Vision Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning Really Learn? Disentangling Tool-Induced and Intrinsic Effects for Crop-and-Zoom
sources.finding: Analyzed tool-use gains mostly reflect intrinsic learning and reduced tool-induced harm, with limited correction of intrinsic failures.
sources.comparability: General VLM analysis; cautionary mechanism evidence, not a diagnosis of this project's failures.

synthesis.recommended_hypothesis: Targeted post-training of a pretrained table-generating VLM using controlled synthetic table pairs and verifiable content-to-cell relationships, with real training-only hard cases and easy-case retention.
synthesis.difference_from_old: Change pretrained generator weights to improve image-to-table output; do not rely on native candidate cells, fixed reread choices or a post-hoc edit gate.
synthesis.novelty: Unproven. LoRA, synthesis, visual grounding and RL individually are established; test the contribution of targeted paired data/objectives against equal-size ordinary synthesis.
synthesis.second_hypothesis: Learned long-table decomposition and context-preserving generation/reassembly, conditional on training-only evidence of truncation/repetition/long-range failures.
synthesis.third_hypothesis: QA/verifiable-reward post-training after a supervised pilot; defer expensive RL until reward fidelity and incremental value are established.
rejected_now: Renaming generic image-grounded correction as new
Sweeping more scales without demonstrated missing capability
Copying full large-scale RL recipes into existing V7 budget
